findings.text: The company was incorporated on 30 July 2014 and its age at cessation is recorded as 4.3 years (1588 days).

The accounts are recorded as of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded; they were last made up to 31 July 2017.
The confirmation statement is recorded as of unknown overdue status, with no next due date and no last made up to date recorded.
Two individuals, PERSON 370 and PERSON 371, are recorded as persons with significant control, each holding 25 to 50 percent ownership of shares.
No charges are registered against the company.
PERSON 368 has 4 other appointments (3 active, 1 dissolved), while PERSON 369 has no other appointments on record; across the two current directors, 4 other companies were found.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
